title: Novo Nordisk’s 6,300-Patient ZEUS Failure: A Textbook Lesson in Translational Risk
summary: ZEUS showed the central translational risk in cardiovascular drug development: ziltivekimab suppressed the IL-6 pathway, but the 6,300-patient outcomes trial did not reduce three-point MACE.
